# Example Calculation workshop
The fictional Example Calculation workshop starts at 09:10 in the north room on 14 November 2026. Bring a blank notebook. No ticket price is specified.

documents.name: Team visit.md
documents.text:
# Team visit
Day teams bring a paper map and a blue pencil, record the gate number before entry, and meet the guide at the east gate. Night teams bring a torch and a red pencil, record the gate number and arrival time before entry, and meet the guide at the west gate. Both teams wait outside until the guide arrives.

documents.name: Sensor check.md
documents.text:
# What the check establishes
A volunteer copies a sensor reading onto a card. An editor compares the card against the saved reading. A successful check means the copied number matches the saved reading. It does not establish that the sensor measured the true temperature.
## Separate uncertainty
The example calculation concerns transcription only. The sensor has no supplied calibration certificate, so its measurement accuracy remains unknown. Repeating the copy check cannot by itself supply the missing calibration.
